source.question: how much did it cost to drill F-1 C and when did it pay for itself

submission.summary: No drilling cost record for well F-1 C was found in the searched reports, so its cost and payback date cannot be calculated from the available evidence. The well produced about 178,000 Sm3 of oil from 2014-04-22 during 438 producing days before abandonment in 2016.

findings.claim: No drilling cost for well F-1 C is recorded in the available reports searched, which only show platform-scale investments and example well costs under different designations.
findings.detail: Searches for F-1 C drilling cost and cost to drill well returned no facts for F-1 C; Table 6.2 costs are for I5, I10, I15, P5, P9, P2, UP1, UP2, not F-1 C. Without a well-specific cost and without an oil price history for payback, payback cannot be calculated.

findings.claim: Well F-1 C first produced oil on 2014-04-22 and produced a total of about 178,000 Sm3 of oil over 438 producing days until 2016-04-21.
findings.detail: list_wells shows first_oil 2014-04-22, cum_oil 177709 Sm3, producing_days 438; well_operations confirms drilling 2014-02-21 to 2014-04-21 (60 report days) and handover 2014-04-21.

findings.claim: Because the tools provide no costs, prices or revenues, the oil volume remaining before a water cut or the time to repay the investment cannot be derived for F-1 C.
findings.detail: No price, tariff or operating-cost history is available per well in the evidence; PUD economics are field-scale NPV at 22 USD/bbl (18.70 USD/bbl for Volve) and cannot be applied to a single well payback.

summaries.summary: Drilled 17 1/2" hole from 1364 m to 1482 m. Circulated bottoms up. Perform check trip to 10 m inside 20" shoe. Drilled 17 1/2" hole to 1502 m.

Drilled 17 1/2" hole from 1502 m to 1540 m. WOW circulated well clean. POOH with 17 1/2" BHA to inside 20" shoe. Performed general service on drilling equipment while WOW. RIH with 17 1/2" BHA to 1540 m. Drilled 17 1/2" hole to 1660 m.

Drilled 17 1/2" hole from 1660 m to 1684 m. Waited one weather, not able to discharge cuttings to vessel due to bad weather. Circulated well clean. POOH with 17 1/2" BHA on 5 1/2" DP to inside 20" shoe. Performed general rig service and PM on drilling equipment.

Correlated and perforated interval #12 (3579 - 3588 m). POOH, inflow tested HMV and SV. L/D tool string #12. M/U perforation assy #13 (3545 - 3554 m). RIH, correlated and perforated interval #13. POOH, inflow tested HMV and SV. L/D tool string #13.

R/D wireline lubricator, riser and BOP. Installed permanent hatch on F-1 slot. Installed XMT cap and R/U for pressure and inflow testing. P/T tree cap, SV, KWV to 35/345 bar. Inflow tested DHSV, HMV, MMV. R/D hose and manifold from KWV. Installed KWV cap.
P/T kill wing cap to 35/345 bar 5/15 min. Well F-1 C handed over to production at 01:30 hrs.
Well handed over from production department to D&W. Started to rig up WL equipment on well.
Completetd rigging up WL equipment. Installed tractor & PLT/RST toolstring. Performed Sigma pass from 3949-3480 m. Logged IC pass from 3785 to 3660 m.
Logged three IC passes and started additional PLT shut in passes.
Completed additional PLT shut in passes. Attempted to bean up well without success. Waiting for well to flow.
Waited for well to flow. Decided to POOH with PLT/RST. Made up perforation BHA and installed same into lubricator.

Installed long perfoartion guns. Had to POOH with long perforation guns due to tension above 50% of cable strength 150 above shooting depth. Decision made to split the perforation guns. RIH with shorter perforation gun.
RIH with short perforation guns and perforated zone from 3733 to 3742,6 m. POOH with BHA#3. RIH with second short perforation gun.

RIH with tractor and perforated . POOH to surface and L/D BHA#4. All shots fired. Observed Bird nest of cable on top of cable head, and wire strands inside tool catcher. Started to flow well. Got production shut down and well was closed in. Started to flow well, seams to stabilize at high rate.
Flowed well to stabilize pressure and rate. Decided to R/D WL equipment. Production closed in well. Inflow tested HMV and DHSV. R/D WL equipment.
R/D WL equipment. Leak tested XT-tree valves. Handed well over OM. Prepared WL equipment for backload. Finished demobilize. End of operation

- Rigged up bleed-off manifold on KWV and installed bleed-off line. - Hooked up Altus pump for local control of HMV and DHSV. - Leak tested bleed-off manifold. Experienced issues with leaking check valve. - Opened HMV and MMV. 29 bar trapped above DHSV. Bled down pressure to 0,3 bar. - Removed tree cap and installed cement spool onto XT. - Attempted to pressure tested cement spool
- Pressure tested cement spool - Bullheaded 50/50 MEG/SW and wash pill - Bullheaded SW until well was free for gas - Bullheaded cement and displaced same - Pressure tested BOP while WOC.

- WOC while monitoring pressure in XT cross. - Pressure tested BOP - Inflow tested and pressure tested cement plug in 7" liner - Attempted to inflow test DHSV - Rigged down cement spool - Installed tree cap on XT

- Rigged down cement spool - Rigged up WL pressure control equipment - Installed return lines and manifold WH to choke manifold - M/U cutter toolstring and RIH - Attempted to cut tubing at 2400 m - POOH w cutter toolstring
- RIH w/ WL cutter run#2 - Cut tubing at 2400 mMD - Displaced A-annulus to SW by pumping 2 x B/U. - Installed ME 572-700 ME plug at 249m - R/D WL equipment - Prepared to N/D XT
- N/D XT and spacer spool - Installed surface riser joint - Pressure tested BOP and TDS - Prepared to skid BOP over well center
- N/U BOP - Installed diverter - Performed connector test - R/U equipment for pulling tubing - RIH w/ THRT
- RIH with 7" spear and retrieved TH - Equalized pressure under ME plug - Performed extended flow check - POOH with 7" tubing. L/D joint w/ME plug and DHSV
-Pulled 7" tubing from 2400 mMD to 374 mMD
- POOH with 7" tubing from 811 mMD to surface - RIH with combined EZSV and cutter BHA from surface to 1393 mMD

Set EZSV in 9 5/8csg at 2390m, tested to 20/165 bar Cut csg, POOH Retrieved MST seal RIH and cut surface tieback csg, POOH, engaged spear and pull csg hanger to surface Started rigging up handling equipment
- Pulled MST seal - Cut 10 3/4 surface tieback csg, pulled same - Released tieback adaptor, pulled same - RIH w/ perforation gun, perforated below 10 3/4 subsea csg hanger

- Perforated below 10 3/4in subsea csg hanger, circulate possible gas, flow checked - M/U and RIH w/ milling BHA, started milling 10 3/4 subsea csg hanger - Milled approximately 20 cm. Due to slow progress POOH to inspect mill
- Milled 10 3/4 in subsea casing hanger - RIH w/ spear BHA, attempted to catch 10 3/4 x 9 5/8 csg fish

- Attempted to fish and pull 10 3/4 x 9 5/8 csg. Engaged fish on spear but not able to pull csg OOH. - Released spear, POOH - RIH w/ 9 5/8 csg cutter, cut csg @ 2361m - Attempted to POOH, got stuck w/ cutter BHA @ 2362m
- Waited for WL cutting equipment to be mobilized. Meanwhile worked on repairing forward PRS - Prepared BHAs for upcoming dressing and fishing runs - R/U WL equipment
None
- Dressed off top of 10 3/4 csg stump - RIH w/ spear and fished 10 3/4 x 9 5/8 csg - Pulled 10 3/4 x 9 5/8 csg to 550m
- Finished pulling 9 5/8 csg - RIH and set 13 3/8 EZSV, placed cement plug on top of EZSV - POOH, waited for cement to set up
- Circulated out excess cement - RIH w/ tagging BHA, milled through restrictions - Tagged top of cement, POOH

- POOH w/ tagging BHA - M/U and RIH w/ 13 3/8in csg cutting tool. Cut 13 3/8in csg at 850m. POOH - P/U and RIH w/ 13 3/8 EZSV. Set plug at 840m, POOH, tested plug to 40bar from above - M/U and RIH w/ TCP BHA, perforated below 13 3/8in csg hanger. POOH

- RIH w/ 13 3/8 EZSV setting tool, circulated to sea water annulus behind 13 3/8 csg - Pumped cement plug in annulus behind 13 3/8 csg - Pumped cement plug on top of 13 3/8 EZSV - Circulated well above cement plug to sea water - WOC while performing BOP test/mainterance/laying out tubing from set back

- WOC, meanwhile performed maintenance on DW, TDS, prepared for N/D BOP, started L/D 7in tbg from derrick - Attempted to pressure test surface cement plug with no success - Continued to L/D 7in tbg from derrick - RIH RTTS BHA, set RTTS in production riser. Attempted to test surface cement plug under RTTS, no success. Released RTTS and POOH - Started N/D BOP
- Pulled diverter - N/D BOP - Pulled HP surface riser - Installed hatch over F-1 slot - Continued reporting on 15/9-F-15D
- Skidded cantilever onto F-1 slot
- N/U BOP and HP riser - Cut 13 3/8in csg - Installed 13 3/8 in EZSV above cut and pressure tested annulus cement plug - Set balanced cement plug on top of EZSV - Started to N/D BOP
- N/D BOP CONTINUE REPORTING ON F-11B
- Skidded to well F-1 C - RIH with inner string - Cut production riser at 134,9 m - Pulled production riser - Installed hatches and prepared to skid rig to F-7.

result.note: Daily reports exist for drilling and for work on the well (wireline, plugs, perforations, production logs), not for days of normal production. A job's date is the day the work was done; kind is drilling, completion, workover (work on a producing or injecting well) or abandonment. Ask for one day to see every operation line.
